title: Natural scalar Hom comparison for a prescribed quotient-system complex
statement: Let l be a prime, E a finite-dimensional field extension of Padic l and X a scheme. Fix a cochain complex Q of modules over the quotient ringed sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], and a coefficient derived-system calculus S [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. On the opposite ordinary unbounded completed-coefficient module derived category, the following functors are naturally isomorphic: (1) derived constant input, followed by constant-ring sequence-site internal Hom into the inverse constant-sequence realization of the completed restriction of Q, followed by R-linear derived sections retaining the tower index [lem-coef-hom-tower-scalar-model]; (2) coefPairingHom S Q, namely quotient-linear internal Hom from S.reduction of the input into Q, followed by coefPairingSections [lem-coef-tower-evaluation-pairing]. The precise functors and their scalar actions are those in the attached Lean statement. This constructs no model Q and assumes no normalized DVR tower.

proof.text: Use the sequence-site scalar internal-Hom adjunction for the completion-projection ring map, with the constant completed input and Q, naturally in the input. Identify restriction with inverse constant-sequence realization and apply the actual derived scalar-section square.

Compose the constant-tower/limit adjunction with scalar extension/restriction. Its right adjoint is coefficientSequenceLimit. Uniqueness of left adjoints compares this extension of the constant input to S.reduction, and normalization identifies their units. Whisker the resulting contravariant natural isomorphism through quotient internal Hom and coefPairingSections. Every comparison is a natural transformation before restriction to constructibles.

lean.statement:
theorem coefHom_scalar_naturality
    (Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E X) ℤ)
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X) :
    Nonempty (
      (coefHomDerivedConstant l E X).op ⋙
        (Functor.curry.obj (coefHomConstantInternalHom l E X)).flip.obj
          ((coefHomEquivalence l E X).inverse.mapDerivedCategory.obj
            ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E X).obj (coefTraceInput l E X Q))) ⋙
        coefHomConstantDerivedSections l E X ≅ coefPairingHom l E X S Q)
